response.title: OTTERNET / Deployment state
response.description: Whether each device matches the configuration Infrahub renders for it, as the deployment reconciler last recorded it in DeploymentState. Read through the Infrahub exporter, so it updates once a minute.

response.title: OTTERNET / Fabric telemetry
response.description: The EOS fabric over gNMI, compared with what Infrahub intends: the BGP sessions in each switch's stored structured config and the links NetworkLink records. Intended-but-down and up-but-never-intended are the panels neither half can show alone.

response.title: OTTERNET / Kubernetes nodes
response.description: The three k3s nodes: what their pods use against the one CPU each node is given, their network, and what Cilium's datapath is doing. Node traffic comes from node-exporter through Telegraf, as the cluster-nodes profile selects it; pod usage from the kubelet; flows from Hubble.

response.title: OTTERNET / Organisation
response.description: The lab at a glance: what is wrong right now across every family, then what Infrahub models -- devices, services, tenants and the changes in flight. Every health tile links to the dashboard that explains it.

response.title: OTTERNET / Perimeter firewall
response.description: fw1 over SNMP v2c, as the perimeter profile selects it: the zone handoffs Infrahub models, the sessions the firewall is holding, and its routing engine.

response.title: OTTERNET / WAN routing
response.description: The WAN's SR Linux routers over gNMI, compared with the BGP neighbours Infrahub models for them. The series are the OpenConfig ones the fabric switches report, filtered to kind DcimDevice; a session's VRF is the network instance the router reports it in.
